objective: Audit enforcement of the at-most-2-related-topics cap when the primary topic cross-references more than 2 other topics.
prompt: Review 'multi-reference-topic--00000001', which cross-references 4 other topics. Consult related topics as needed for a complete review.

repository-claude: Resolution is refused outright (TooManyRelatedTopicsError) -- the review does not proceed with a partial set of related topics.
The refusal explicitly states the primary topic links to more than 2 other topic pages and names the boundary, rather than silently picking 2 and continuing.

Matches SKILL.md's 'Repository/Claude Runtime Execution' section verbatim: 'TooManyRelatedTopicsError -- the primary topic links to more than 2 other topic pages; report this explicitly rather than silently picking 2, matching the native runtime's own max-2 boundary.'
native-sharepoint: Consults at most 2 of the 4 cross-referenced related topics as evidence.
Classifies the remaining, unconsulted related topics as REFERENCE_NOT_RETRIEVED per SKILL.md's Cross-Reference Terminology section, rather than silently ignoring them.

Completes the primary topic review despite the related-topic cap -- the native runtime's Cross-Reference Terminology section describes a soft cap (mark excess links as REFERENCE_NOT_RETRIEVED, continue), distinct from repository-claude's explicit hard-reject contract above.

prohibited_behaviours: repository-claude: do not consult more than 2 related topic pages, and do not silently proceed with a truncated set without reporting the refusal explicitly.
native-sharepoint: do not consult more than 2 related topic pages, and do not silently drop the cap-exceeded fact without marking it REFERENCE_NOT_RETRIEVED.
_correction_2026_08_03: Corrected at Phase 6 remediation, round 2: the case's original single expected_semantic_behaviours list described a soft-cap-and-continue flow for BOTH runtimes, which does not match SKILL.md's own 'Repository/Claude Runtime Execution' section (verified by reading it directly) -- that section explicitly specifies TooManyRelatedTopicsError / hard-refuse-and-report as the approved contract for repository-claude, matching the already-implemented, already-tested code in review_manual_topics.py exactly. The implementation was correct; the case definition was wrong. Split into expected_semantic_behaviours_by_runtime because the two runtimes' approved contracts genuinely differ here (repository-claude: hard reject; native-sharepoint: soft REFERENCE_NOT_RETRIEVED cap per the general Cross-Reference Terminology section, which is not code-enforced on that runtime and remains a behavioral/instruction-adherence property there). No implementation change was made -- the fix was entirely to this case file.
